scope: Revalidate the exact locked LibreCAD semantic-adapter target against the active standalone callback profile, then refresh current peer release and specification evidence that affects the next implementation slice.

localTarget.result: The locked target static library built successfully. The semantic adapter translation unit failed compilation with 16 diagnostics, grouped into six missing API contracts; repeated diagnostics include the adapter self-test references.

method.externalEvidence: Read-only review of current Autodesk reference, LibreDWG NEWS, ACadSharp release history and merged PR; no peer package or native CAD application was installed or run.
notPerformed: full test suite, sanitizer, or fuzz run
DWG/DXF fixture download or repository addition
peer or native CAD runtime comparison
target lock refresh or sibling LibreCAD checkout edit

observed.repetitions: The absent chunk type/member diagnostics repeat in helper, callback, and linked self-test code paths.

targetStillProvides: common modeler version/body size/object size and flags
evidence.interpretation: This is a reproducible compile/API-coverage blocker for the active 7AG.1 bridge, not a DWG/DXF parsing defect or evidence of semantic mismatch. Missing target members cannot be observed as zero, false, empty bytes, or a digest.

evidence.observed: The Autodesk 3DSOLID DXF reference lists modeler subclass/version, proprietary group 1 and additional group 3 payload strings, and soft-owner group 350 history handle.

evidence.topic: Current ACadSharp release and reader-route maturity
observed: The release page lists v3.8.0 at signed commit 3a1c66b; its listed change is assembly visibility.
v3.7.16 at 3feabba lists DXF writer refactoring/precision, block-insert indexing, and large-table output among its changes.
v3.6.51 includes the merged ACIS payload reader work for 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY and the full Prototype1b parser work.
doesNotEstablish: independent runtime success on this project's controls
evidence.planUse: Pin exact package/source and route for optional comparator runs; do not infer new semantic coverage from the v3.8.0 release label alone or add per-slice scale testing.

evidence.topic: Current LibreDWG route-specific security and DXF fixes
evidence.observed: NEWS for 0.14.1 dated 2026-07-25 reports R2004 decompression capacity/logical-size mismatch that bypassed an earlier fix, section-map/size arithmetic and page-offset cases, a DWG 3DSOLID size-check overflow, and additional DXF/ACIS output corrections.
doesNotEstablish: that peer security fixes qualify local behavior
evidence.planUse: Map analogous local changes only to existing PAR-14/7BE and bounded ACIS readers; add narrowly generated invariants when a corresponding local code path changes, keeping fuzz/sanitizer cadence at existing checkpoints.

requiredSteps: Use dependent compile-time member detection or an equivalent reviewed per-side capability profile so target-absent fields do not appear in target expressions.
Represent absent, uncaptured, captured, and comparable as distinct field states; never substitute zero/false/empty payload for absence.
Extend adapter self-tests for both target-absent and standalone-present capability paths and runner mutation tests for capability/profile mismatches.
Compile and link target and standalone adapters against their exact source locks before any new pair is issued.
Keep the pair ineligible until the effective compile-contract gate is enforced; current direct-options-only receipts remain diagnostic.
fastValidation: strict warning build and diff check
implementationReadiness.fullSuiteOrNativeRun: Not required for the capability bridge; retain composed/scheduled cadence.
